A small update with fixes for Windows updates and for starting the app offline.

## Fixed
- **Windows auto-update works again.** Since 1.1.2 the update download failed because the installer's file name didn't match the update information. Installers are now named without spaces.
- **No "Update check failed" message when you're offline.** The automatic check at startup now fails quietly. An update check you start yourself in Settings still tells you if it fails.

## Other
- The repository now includes an MIT LICENSE file.

## Notes
- Windows and macOS builds aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may warn the first time you open the app.
- On Linux, the AppImage runs without the Chromium sandbox on systems that block it, such as Ubuntu 24.04. The .deb keeps the sandbox on.
